title: Gas sniffer aims to save lives by helping the public detect leaks

input.summary: Rhinologist James Dyson ensure gas supplies have the correct odour - essential for spotting leaks

Before she died, she made Kit's half-sister, Gemma Winter-Brown, aware that the family may carry the familial BRCA gene Carrying a familial BRCA (Breast Cancer) gene mutation means inheriting a harmful change in the BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes from a parent, which significantly raises your lifetime risk of developing certain cancers But as their mum, Bernie Winter-Alahan, and Gemma face testing, unbeknownst to them, Kit has already been seeking medical help due to concerns about his own health and was recently diagnosed with stage 3 breast cancer, something almost 500 men in the UK face every year The Coronation Street production team are working closely with Macmillan Cancer Support and Breast Cancer Now to accurately portray Kit’s cancer while raising awareness of the very real risks of the illness amongst men

Marc says his typical Friday shift starts at 2am before closing up ahead of the Sabbath If he's catering for an event, his alarm clock will go off even earlier. If he has a 6am flight for a holiday he'll still be working at midnight - much to his wife's dismay, Marc admits - and when returning he'll often ask the taxi driver to drop him off at the deli It was particularly busy in the days before Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish new year, which took place last weekend. Marc said: "From the Tuesday to the Friday, I had three hours' sleep in all that time and I went home four times for a shower. That was it. Other than that I was here." input.lead: Bolton Car Boot Sale at Bolton Car Boot Sale
input.summary: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. It runs every Sunday from February right through to December, drawing over 300 sellers and t
input.evidence_text: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. It runs every Sunday from February right through to December, drawing over 300 sellers and thousands of bargain hunters each week. Sellers can arrive and set up from 6:00 AM, with buyers welcomed in from 7:00 AM. Entry costs just £1 per car for buyers. Pitches for sellers are £14 for a car, £20 for a van and £3 for a trailer, with regular and corner pitches available on request. Bring exact change to keep the queue moving, and call organiser Andrew on 07470784644 for more details. Expect hundreds of stalls across the concrete hardstanding pitches, so it goes ahead in most weather. On-site you'll find a 5-star catering service, doughnuts and coffee, ice cream and desserts, a meat auction, fresh fruit and veg, plants, and retro sweet stalls. The sale is dog-friendly, has male and female toilets, ample parking, and kids' rides and bouncy castles to keep little ones entertained.
